messages:
Marcos R.: Heads up — invoice BR-5962 from SaoCloud Ops arrived (BRL 72,450). Vendor is asking us to "gross-up" for local municipal service tax (ISS) and claims we must withhold 2.0% at source. They provided a CNPJ but the PDF shows the number without punctuation (14233456000199). Should we withhold ISS or ask for formal tax docs?

Priya T.: Do we have their vendor record? If they are a Brazilian legal entity (CNPJ) and services were performed in Brazil, ISS rules can apply but withholding is typically handled by the payer only in some municipalities. Need to confirm municipal requirement and whether vendor expects payer withholding.

Lucas M.: Vendor says municipality = São Paulo and attached a handwritten note "withhold 2% municipal tax". No formal DARF or local withholding certificate. They also attached a signed invoice PDF with CNPJ: 14233456000199 and address in São Paulo.

Tax-bot: Quick tax note: For Brazil, ISS is a municipal tax on services (rates vary by municipality). Some municipalities require the payer to withhold the ISS and remit locally when the supplier is not registered for the municipal service regime or depending on local law. Withholding should be supported by local guidance and vendor's municipal registration (Inscrição Municipal) or a declaration. Do NOT gross-up without documentation.

Marcos R.: OK placing payment on hold while we confirm. Drafting vendor message. We need: (1) a copy of the vendor's Inscrição Municipal for São Paulo or municipal registration proof, (2) confirmation whether supplier requests Redwood to withhold ISS and remit, and (3) bank details and whether they want payment BRL or USD.

Priya T.: Also ask them to provide CNPJ in formatted form (14 digits with punctuation or confirm number). We'll validate CNPJ against Receita database. If they ask us to withhold, we need a signed declaration and local guidance showing payer withholding is required for that municipality. If not required, vendor should invoice gross and we pay net.

AP-bot: Hold set on BR-5962 — reason: IBAN/CNPJ/ISS withholding documentation pending. AP queue notified.

Lucas M.: Vendor replied in thread: "We request 2% ISS withheld. We will accept net payment. Attached fiscal note (nota fiscal de serviços) but it's a scanned PDF, not the municipal registration."

Marcos R.: Scanned NF alone isn't sufficient. Sending vendor message now: "Hi SaoCloud Ops — thanks for BR-5962. To proceed we need either (A) municipal registration proof for São Paulo (Inscrição Municipal) and citation of the municipal ordinance that requires payer withholding, or (B) a supplier declaration confirming they will issue a corrected invoice and remit ISS themselves (no withholding by Redwood). Please confirm currency preference. Payment will be held until documentation is provided."

Tax-bot: If vendor provides ordinance or municipal guidance authorizing payer withholding, Tax will evaluate and instruct AP on gross-up vs withholding mechanics and ledger treatment. If payer withholding is required, Redwood must remit the withheld amount to the municipality and obtain the local DARF/guia for proof.

Priya T.: Noted. I will attempt a quick CNPJ lookup and check São Paulo municipal site for the vendor's registration number. If vendor cannot provide the Inscrição Municipal, we should not withhold.

AP-bot: Outbound message sent to finance@sao-cloud.example at 2026-12-02T10:15:22Z. Hold expiry set to 2026-12-09 unless docs received earlier.

Marcos R.: Thanks all — will reopen when vendor responds or Tax confirms ordinance. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
